candidates.title: RPSC: Robust LLM Scheduling by Tolerating Prediction Inaccuracy and Mitigating Tail Latency
candidates.reason: Production-oriented LLM scheduling that explicitly models prediction error, preemption cost, KV swapping/recomputation and tail latency; reports 33.6% fewer redundant preemptions and 20.3% better P99 JCT.

candidates.title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
candidates.reason: KV-cache compression method designed around serving-kernel constraints: entropy coding with fixed-size per-token bitstreams for regular memory access and parallel attention dequantization.

candidates.title: Where Should the KV Cache Live? Placement Policies Across GPU, CPU, and SSD for Long-Lived Sessions
candidates.reason: Direct hierarchical-memory KV-cache placement study across GPU/CPU/SSD for long-lived sessions, including workload-specific policy and prefetch evaluation; highly relevant to SSD-tiered LLM serving.
